summary: A tool that changes something waits for a person's yes. You add a risky tool behind an approval, with the checks in the right order (rights, input, approval, action), an action that is safe to repeat, and tests that prove nothing changes without a yes. You also learn five questions for choosing an agent, a workflow or a single call.
goal: Add an approval step before a risky tool.

items.text: Update agent.py and pretend_agent.py, add approval_demo.py and match the four runs
Run without an approver and predict what happens
Move the approval before the permission check and say what goes wrong
Decide agent, workflow or one call for three features of your project
Play the Approval Check game to the end and see your score
